brand.name: Active Arenal
brand.seo_title: Active Arenal · Local tours in La Fortuna and Arenal Volcano
brand.seo_desc: Small-group tours around La Fortuna and Arenal: Río Celeste, rafting, sloths, hanging bridges, volcano hikes and river safari. Hotel pickup, local guides, book online.
brand.h1: Real adventure in the heart of Arenal.
brand.sub: Local guides, small groups and pickup at your hotel in La Fortuna. Choose your day, see real availability and pay securely by card.
tape: Pickup at your hotel in La Fortuna
brand.moods_lead: Every tour leaves from La Fortuna with pickup at your door. Start with the kind of day you want, we take care of the rest.
brand.combos_lead: Pair a river morning with an afternoon on the volcano, the bridges or a waterfall. One pickup, one booking, a full day well spent.
brand.reviews_note: Rated Excellent by 331 travelers on Tripadvisor. Same owner, same guides: Leo Rodríguez and the team behind Costa Rica Driver & Adventure, now focused on tours from La Fortuna.
brand.footer_blurb: Tours from La Fortuna with the local team of Leo Rodríguez. Small groups, real guides, a day you will keep talking about.
brand.legal_note: Part of Costa Rica Driver & Adventure, serving travelers since 2002.
brand.band_title: Nothing here rushes. The river, the sloth, the volcano.
brand.band_text: We leave from La Fortuna, the town we know best. Small groups, guides who grew up here, and time to actually look around.
